title: Nightshift handoff playbook - scratch
body:
Purpose: personal scratchpad for a lightweight manager script and agent checklist to run a temporary consolidation of live-chat coverage overnight while new hires finish onboarding. This is a working document intended to be pared down into a short FAQ and canned replies.

Summary (short): Consolidate live-chat presence nightly to a single regional queue for 5 weeks to let new EMEA hires shadow and graduate into independent coverage. This reduces distributed chat-monitoring complexity overnight and centralizes triage. Not an outage; critical paths preserved.

Why now: EMEA onboarding cohort finishes remote shadowing by late March; consolidating overnight for 5 weeks reduces context-switching and speeds training. Also timed to avoid planned product launch windows.

Timing: start Monday 2026-04-05; nightly window 00:30-04:30 PT; planned end Sunday 2026-05-09 (5-week run).

High-level customer line (one sentence): Were centralizing overnight live-chat triage temporarily so our new EMEA colleagues can ramp faster; tickets and critical incidents remain covered.

Customer-facing blurb (short, editable): "From April 5 through May 9 we will consolidate our overnight live-chat triage to a single regional queue to support a training ramp. You can still open tickets and for urgent incidents we maintain our emergency ops bridge. Expected initial triage for non-urgent tickets is within two hours. Thank you for your patience while we improve global coverage."

Manager opening script (30-60s):
- Lead: "Quick heads-up: for five weeks well centralize overnight chat to speed EMEA training. This is temporary and were keeping P0/P1 paths unchanged. Youll get a pinned FAQ and a short checklist to run in your huddles."
- Reassurance: "This is about training efficiency, not headcount reduction. If your shift preferences change, come talk to me; well be flexible."

Micro-scripts for team huddles (copy-paste friendly):
- "Main change: 00:30-04:30 PT evening queues will show a single active chat queue. If you see a customer ask during that window, please open a ticket and use template 'Night triage - received' to set expectations. P0s -> ops-bridge as usual."
- "Before your shift ends: make a 1-line handoff note in the ticket and ping your buddy in #cs-night-handoffs."

Exact canned responses (short):
- Non-urgent auto-reply (chat): "Thanks for reaching out — our overnight team is triaging now. Please open a ticket at <help.link> for non-urgent requests; we aim to triage within 2 hours."
- Triage confirmation (ticket): "Got it — your ticket is in our overnight triage queue. An engineer will review within 2 hours. For urgent incidents, we will escalate immediately via our ops bridge."
- P0 escalation acknowledgement: "Escalation received. Initiating ops bridge and notifying SRE on-call now."

Agent checklist (quick, one-line steps):
1) Set Slack status to: "Night triage: ticket-first" during the window.
2) Use canned reply for new chat/drop-ins.
3) If you suspect P0: start ops-bridge, tag #sre-oncall, DM lead.
4) Leave a 1-line handoff summary in ticket before sign-off.

Handoff template (one line):
- "[Time] - short summary - customer impact - next step (e.g., waiting logs/eng review)."

Ops test plan (one-paragraph):
- Walkthrough to run this week: 1) test ops-bridge dial and recording, 2) confirm SRE can join from mobile, 3) have a 20-minute simulated P0 at 02:00 PT with the training group so routing and notifications are verified, 4) confirm the auto-reply flows to chat->ticket correctly. Owner: Ravi. Deadline: 2026-03-20.

Escalation flow (short):
- P0: ops-bridge -> SRE on-call -> Eng lead -> Customer success director.
- P1: CS L2 -> Eng on-call if code-related; otherwise CS resolves.
- Billing/account pressure: escalate to account lead and CSM (list maintained in sheet).

Staffing & fairness notes:
- Rotas: managers must ensure even distribution of late shifts; offer 1 flex day per 3 overnight shifts during the 5-week window.
- Opt-out: allow limited opt-outs for hardship; managers to log requests to people-ops.

Monitoring (dashboard KPIs):
- Median initial triage time for 00:30-04:30 PT (goal < 2h).
- Number of P0s raised overnight and P0 MTTR.
- Chat-to-ticket conversion ratio.
- Weekly agent pulse for night cohort (one-question survey).

Example Slack announcement (threaded):
Post: "Heads-up: starting April 5 were centralizing overnight triage 00:30-04:30 PT for five weeks to support training. See pinned FAQ in #cs-ops. Managers: please run a 10-min huddle today."
Thread replies to anticipate:
- Q: "Will this increase my late-night work?" A: "Were redistributing; managers will balance shifts and offer flex credits. Talk to your manager."
- Q: "Is the ops-bridge still active?" A: "Yes — P0 path unchanged."

Manager checklist this week:
- Pin FAQ in team channel.
- Schedule 10-min huddle before Apr 5.
- Confirm buddy pairs in the schedule and publish.
- Run ops-bridge test (owner: Ravi).

Risks and mitigations (short):
- Customer confusion: mitigate with clear short blurb + help-center banner.
- Uneven shift burden: mitigate with manager oversight, flex credits, and opt-out process.
- Missed P0: mitigate with mandatory ops-bridge test and SRE confirmation.

Communication owners (who does what):
- Draft final customer blurb: Communications (Noelle sign-off).
- Ops-bridge test owner: Ravi (SRE).
- Canned replies + help center banner: Harper (CS).

Short timeline:
- 2026-03-16: managers notified + canned replies drafted.
- 2026-03-23: ops-bridge test complete.
- 2026-04-05: run starts.
- 2026-04-19: first checkpoint; adjust if needed.
- 2026-05-09: end and retro.

Open asks for this week:
- People Ops: confirm flex-credit approval (Noelle).
- SRE: confirm mobile ops-bridge join reliability (Ravi).
- CS: confirm three canned replies and help-center banner text (Harper).

Notes to self (todo, short):
- Copy triage SLA numbers into FAQ from metric dashboard.
- Draft a 2-slide manager brief for huddles.
- Run the simulated P0 at 02:00 PT with trainees.

Quick links (placeholders):
- Confluence runbook: CONFLUENCE:CUST-NIGHT-2026
- Test ticket: JIRA:CS-4509
- Manager slides PR: GITHUB:/cs-ops/handbook/pull/22

End of scratchpad: raw notes intended for managers and ops leads. Will trim and publish after leadership sign-off.
